review.visual: All three inspected: cohesive underwater scenery, empty combat floors, no characters or UI.

Reference image 1 (world-5 cavern) is the authoritative battle painting quality, depth and wide empty ground composition reference, NOT its cave location. Reference image 2 (7B map) supplies the underwater region's pearly cream stone, teal/indigo water, restrained gold, violet coral and blue palace architecture only; DO NOT copy its overhead map camera, path, waypoint crystals or markers. Create finely hand-painted premium mobile fantasy RPG environment art, dimensional stone, nuanced materials, atmospheric depth, delicate colored edges, polished soft lighting, rich readable teal and cool blue-violet shadows with restrained mint and violet crystal light. Favor large architectural shapes readable when shrunk to a mobile battle panel. NO figures, characters, monsters, silhouettes, statues of people, weapons, loot, waypoint pedestals, UI, letters, numbers, text, logos, watermark, panel frames. No pixel art, low-poly or plastic 3D, gritty horror, excessive bloom, clutter or fish crossing the combat lane. This is a battle scenery illustration, NOT a world map. Scene: Ordinary black lizardman encounters in the Black Lake of the Abyss. A breathable underwater ruined sluice passage, broken cream-stone arches and weathered gate remnants set back on both sides, a broad flat pearly stone foreground terrace, shell fragments and muted violet coral at the extreme edges only. Beyond the arches is deep navy teal lake water with softly filtered cyan caustic beams descending from above; a distant blue-roof underwater palace barely visible. Mysterious aquatic adventure, pleasantly luminous floor, no daylight sky.
